items.title: Kyren Williams: Tallies 121 scrimmage yards, TD in win
items.text:
Williams rushed 16 times for 99 yards and a touchdown and brought in both targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Christian Watson: Five more catches in Week 7
items.text:
Watson notched five catches (on eight targets) for 57 yards and no touchdowns during Sunday's 20-17 defeat at Detroit.

items.title: Tyler Allgeier: Outproduced by Knight again
items.text:
Allgeier rushed eight times for 19 yards and caught all three of his targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Red-zone struggles persist in Week 7
items.text:
Brissett completed 27 of 48 passes for 272 yards and a touchdown while rushing seven times for 16 yards in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Catches four of eight Week 7 targets
items.text:
Wilson caught four of eight targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 30-16 loss to the Broncos. He also rushed twice for 11 yards.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Eight catches in Week 7 win
items.text:
Nacua brought in eight of 10 targets for 68 yards and a touchdown and rushed twice for 10 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Raiders on Sunday.

items.title: Jordan Love: Throws two more TDs
items.text:

items.title: Jonah Coleman: Team-high nine carries in return
items.text:
Coleman (ankle) rushed nine times for 54 yards and caught both of his targets for 15 yards in Sunday's 30-16 win over the Cardinals.

items.title: J.K. Dobbins: Extends TD streak but outplayed by Coleman
items.text:
